question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities remain a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which child items should instead move to plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The tracker proposes new dashboard concepts, persistent widget/workspace state, widget execution, registry/install flows, and security boundaries that cleanup automation cannot safely choose as product direction.

options.title: Sponsor selectively under review
options.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage/security boundaries before each merge.

options.title: Move optional pieces outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer the roadmap
options.body: Pause the Wave 2+ tracker if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor selectively under review
recommendation.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage/security boundaries before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the plugin-tab seam plus project-level product/security authority listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
